entries.en: The workshop reserved the A-grade wool for its finest scarves.
entries.zh: 工坊把甲级羊毛留作制作最精美的围巾。

entries.en: Her a-historical reading ignored the period in which the novel was written.
entries.zh: 她那种与历史无关的解读忽略了小说写作的时代背景。

entries.en: The A-list performers agreed to rehearse without an audience.
entries.zh: 那些一流的表演者同意在没有观众的情况下排练。

entries.en: A-one craftsmanship made the simple cabinet worth keeping.
entries.zh: 一流的工艺让这个简单的柜子值得保留。

entries.en: The club remained deliberately a-political despite pressure from several campaign groups.
entries.zh: 尽管受到几个竞选团体的施压，俱乐部仍刻意不关心政治。

entries.en: The leaf sample had a small tear along its abapical margin.
entries.zh: 叶片样本远离尖端的边缘有一道小裂口。

entries.en: The trainee confused an abarticular structure with the joint itself.
entries.zh: 实习生把一个关节外的结构误认成了关节本身。

entries.en: The curator placed the Abbassid coin beside the newly restored manuscript.
entries.zh: 馆长把那枚阿拔斯王朝的硬币放在新修复的手稿旁。

entries.en: The parser rejected the abbreviative notation used in the old configuration file.
entries.zh: 解析器拒绝了旧配置文件中使用的缩写记法。

entries.en: An abbreviatory command form saved space in the tiny console window.
entries.zh: 缩略的命令形式节省了小控制台窗口中的空间。

entries.en: The abdicant left the palace before the new ruler arrived.
entries.zh: 新统治者到来之前，那位退位者离开了宫殿。

entries.en: The drawing distinguishes the embryonic and abembryonic poles.
entries.zh: 图中区分了靠近胚胎和远离胚胎的两极。

entries.en: The aberrated image was excluded from the comparison set.
entries.zh: 那幅异常图像被排除在对比组之外。

entries.en: The moldmaker tested a new abhesive on a spare plate.
entries.zh: 模具制作工在一块备用板上试用了新的阻粘剂。

entries.en: An abhuman guards the ruined city in her fantasy novel.
entries.zh: 在她的奇幻小说中，一个亚人类守卫着那座废城。

entries.en: The lecture compared abiogenic deposits with those linked to biological activity.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了非生物体产生的沉积物与那些跟生物活动有关的沉积物。

entries.en: She translated the short passage from Abkhazian into English.
entries.zh: 她把那段短文从阿布哈西亚语译成了英语。

entries.en: The harbor was ablare with whistles before the ferry departed.
entries.zh: 渡轮离港前，港口里响着喧闹的汽笛声。

entries.en: The botanist set the ablastous specimen apart from the budding shoots.
entries.zh: 植物学家把无芽标本与正在萌芽的枝条分开。

entries.en: The tutor circled the ablatival ending but left the noun stem unchanged.
entries.zh: 辅导教师圈出了离格词尾，但没有改动名词词干。

entries.en: The able-minded organizer found a way to seat everyone without extra chairs.
entries.zh: 那位能干的组织者想出了不用加椅子就让所有人就座的办法。

entries.en: The village asked for ablebodied volunteers to help move the fallen branches.
entries.zh: 村里征召身体强健的志愿者，帮忙搬走掉落的树枝。

entries.meaningZh: 身体健全的；无残疾的〔指体格〕
entries.en: The venue welcomes both abled and disabled performers.
entries.zh: 这个场地欢迎身体健全和有残疾的表演者。

entries.en: An abluent dissolved the greasy film on the metal plate.
entries.zh: 一种洗洁剂溶去了金属板上的油膜。

entries.en: The freshly abluted cups stood upside down on a clean cloth.
entries.zh: 刚洗净的杯子倒扣在干净的布上。

entries.en: The anatomist marked the abneural side of the specimen with ink.
entries.zh: 解剖学家用墨水标记了标本神经外侧的一面。

entries.en: The old tale describes a bird of abnormous size perched above the gate.
entries.zh: 那个古老的故事描写了一只体型异常的鸟，栖在大门上方。

entries.en: The editor corrected the above-cited figure but kept the surrounding paragraph.
entries.zh: 编辑更正了上面所引的数字，却保留了周围的段落。

entries.en: The above-ground pipes froze before the buried section did.
entries.zh: 地面上的管道先于埋在地下的部分冻住了。

entries.en: The chart showed above-normal demand throughout the festival weekend.
entries.zh: 图表显示，整个节庆周末的需求都高于正常水平。

entries.en: The engineer photographed the bridge's above-water structure from a small boat.
entries.zh: 工程师从小船上拍摄了桥梁水面以上的结构。

entries.en: Please return the abovementioned forms before the office closes on Friday.
entries.zh: 请在周五办公室关门前交回上述表格。

entries.en: The machinist covered the abrasable surface before stacking the parts.
entries.zh: 机械加工师先盖住易磨损的表面，再把零件堆放起来。

entries.en: The publisher considered the long appendix abridgable, but the author disagreed.
entries.zh: 出版商认为那个长附录可以删节，但作者不同意。

entries.en: The absent-minded host put the teaspoons in the refrigerator.
entries.zh: 心不在焉的主人把茶匙放进了冰箱。

entries.en: The priest read the absolutory prayer before the service ended.
entries.zh: 神父在礼拜结束前念了赦免罪过的祷文。

entries.en: He considered the minor breach absolvable once the missing papers were returned.
entries.zh: 遗失的文件归还后，他认为那次轻微违规是可以宽恕的。

entries.en: The archivist placed the absolvent decree beside the prisoner's release order.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把赦免令放在囚犯的释放令旁。

entries.en: An absonant note from the trumpet disrupted the otherwise gentle melody.
entries.zh: 小号发出的一个不和谐音打乱了原本柔和的旋律。

entries.en: The cleaner used too much abstergent, leaving foam across the tiles.
entries.zh: 清洁工用了过多洗洁剂，瓷砖上满是泡沫。

entries.en: The label described the powder's abstersive properties but listed no ingredients.
entries.zh: 标签描述了这种粉末的去垢特性，却没有列出成分。

entries.meaningZh: 非常活跃的；非常兴奋的
entries.en: The reception hall was abubble with excited conversation after the announcement.
entries.zh: 消息宣布后，接待大厅里满是兴奋而热烈的交谈声。

entries.en: A second bridge was still abuilding when the old ferry stopped running.
entries.zh: 旧渡轮停航时，第二座桥仍在建造中。

entries.en: The kitchen was abustle with volunteers preparing the evening meal.
entries.zh: 志愿者们准备晚餐，厨房里一片忙碌。

entries.en: The documentary included brief footage of abyssopelagic life.
entries.zh: 纪录片中有一小段深渊海洋生物的影像。

entries.en: The lecture compared calculous and acalculous cases without discussing treatment.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了有结石和无结石的病例，但没有讨论治疗。

entries.en: The botanist separated the acalycine flowers from the specimens with visible calyces.
entries.zh: 植物学家把无花萼的花与有明显花萼的标本分开。

entries.en: The climber caught his sleeve on the acanthaceous shrub.
entries.zh: 登山者的衣袖钩在了那株有棘的灌木上。

entries.en: The mason repaired the acanthine carving above the doorway.
entries.zh: 石匠修复了门口上方那片刺叶状雕饰。

entries.en: The microbiologist noted an acapsular variant in the comparison table.
entries.zh: 微生物学家在比较表中记下了一个无荚膜变体。

entries.en: An acaroid creature crawled across the microscope's field of view.
entries.zh: 一只螨状生物爬过显微镜的视野。

entries.en: An acaulose plant filled the shallow pot with a tight rosette of leaves.
entries.zh: 一株无茎植物长出紧密的莲座状叶丛，铺满了浅花盆。

entries.en: The crew celebrated an accident-free year with a meal at the depot.
entries.zh: 全体工作人员在车场聚餐，庆祝一年来无事故。

entries.en: The accidentalist challenged the claim that every event must be determined.
entries.zh: 那个偶然论者质疑了每件事都必然被决定的说法。

entries.en: The accidented terrain forced the survey team to abandon the wheeled cart.
entries.zh: 凹凸不平的地形迫使测量队弃用带轮的小车。

entries.en: The sculptor gave the bronze mask an accipitral profile.
entries.zh: 雕塑家给青铜面具塑造了鹰似的侧面轮廓。

entries.en: An acclamatory roar greeted the winning team as the doors opened.
entries.zh: 门一打开，迎接获胜队伍的是一阵欢呼声。

entries.en: The loaded cart slowed on the acclive path beside the orchard.
entries.zh: 满载的小车在果园旁的上斜小路上慢了下来。

entries.en: The builder raised the lower edge to level the acclivous floor.
entries.zh: 施工者抬高较低的一边，把向上倾斜的地板调平。

entries.en: She found the plan accommodable to the needs of a larger household.
entries.zh: 她发现这个方案可以适应更大家庭的需要。

entries.en: The architect calculated how many desks were accommodatable within the existing room.
entries.zh: 建筑师计算了现有房间能容纳多少张书桌。

entries.en: The accommodationists argued for compromise while the rival faction demanded a boycott.
entries.zh: 那些妥协迁就者主张妥协，而对立派要求抵制。

entries.en: The usually aloof curator seemed surprisingly accostable after the lecture.
entries.zh: 讲座之后，那位平时冷淡的馆长显得出奇地容易接近。

entries.en: The botanical drawing showed an accrescent calyx surrounding the young fruit.
entries.zh: 植物图画呈现了围着幼果逐渐增大的花萼。

entries.en: The geologist examined the accumulational layers exposed beside the old road.
entries.zh: 地质学家检查了旧路旁露出的堆积层。

entries.en: The inquiry found no accusable person among the temporary staff.
entries.zh: 调查没有在临时员工中发现可指控的人。

entries.en: The student replaced the nominative pronoun with its accusatival form.
entries.zh: 学生把主格代词换成了宾格形式。

entries.en: Her work made her ace-high with the usually skeptical crew.
entries.zh: 她的工作让她赢得了那群向来多疑的工作人员的喜爱。

entries.en: The fossil's acentrous vertebrae required a separate note in the catalog.
entries.zh: 化石中无椎体的椎骨需要在目录中另作说明。

entries.en: The apothecary kept an acesodyne in a small locked cabinet.
entries.zh: 药剂师把一种止痛药放在一个上锁的小柜里。

entries.en: The shell had an acetabuliform depression near its broken edge.
entries.zh: 那个壳破损的边缘附近有一处碟状凹陷。

entries.en: The gardener reserved the acetarious herbs for the kitchen rather than the display beds.
entries.zh: 园丁把适合凉拌食用的草本植物留给了厨房，而没有种进展览花坛。

entries.en: The report lists several acetylable compounds but gives no yields.
entries.zh: 报告列出了几种可乙酰化的化合物，却没有给出产率。

entries.en: The chemist separated the acetylisable fraction before repeating the experiment.
entries.zh: 化学家分离出可乙酰化的部分，然后重复了实验。

entries.en: The lecturer contrasted chiasmate and achiasmate chromosome pairs.
entries.zh: 讲师对比了有交叉和无交叉的染色体对。

entries.en: My shoulders were achiest after carrying the crates upstairs.
entries.zh: 把木箱搬上楼后，我的肩膀最疼。

entries.en: The anatomist corrected the label on the achordal part of the model.
entries.zh: 解剖学家更正了模型无脊索部分的标签。

entries.en: The achroic sample was almost invisible against the glass tray.
entries.zh: 那份无色样本放在玻璃托盘上几乎看不见。

entries.en: The slide contained several achromatophilic cells among the darkly stained ones.
entries.zh: 玻片上有几个不染色的细胞，夹在深染的细胞之间。

entries.en: The histologist compared the achromophilous regions under the same illumination.
entries.zh: 组织学家在相同照明条件下比较了那些不染色的区域。

entries.en: Aciculated crystals lined the inside of the broken stone.
entries.zh: 那块破石头内部布满了针状结晶。

entries.en: The jeweler removed an aciculiform splinter from the edge of the setting.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠从镶座边缘取下了一根针形碎片。

entries.en: The team replaced the cracked tray with an acid-resistant one.
entries.zh: 团队用一个耐酸托盘换下了开裂的托盘。

entries.en: The acid-tongued critic praised the costumes but mocked the dialogue.
entries.zh: 那位言语尖刻的评论家赞扬了服装，却嘲讽了对白。

entries.en: The technician kept the acidiferous waste separate from the clean rinse water.
entries.zh: 技术员把含酸废物与干净的冲洗水分开存放。

entries.en: The nursery moved the acidofuge plants out of the experimental bed.
entries.zh: 苗圃把嫌酸的植物移出了试验花坛。

entries.en: The botanist crossed the acidophobous species off the planting list.
entries.zh: 植物学家把嫌酸的物种从种植清单中划掉。

entries.en: The report listed the acidoresistant strains separately from the other isolates.
entries.zh: 报告把抗酸菌株与其他分离株分开列出。

entries.en: The worker inspected the acidproof lining for cracks before the demonstration.
entries.zh: 工人在演示前检查了耐酸衬里是否有裂纹。

entries.en: The aciform tip pierced the thick cardboard with little pressure.
entries.zh: 那尖如针的末端稍一用力就刺穿了厚纸板。

entries.en: The researcher compared the aciliate cells with those bearing visible cilia.
entries.zh: 研究员把无纤毛细胞与有明显纤毛的细胞作了比较。

entries.en: An aciniform ornament hung from the clasp of the necklace.
entries.zh: 项链扣环上垂着一个葡萄串状的饰物。

entries.en: The acleidian skeleton in the teaching collection needed a new support.
entries.zh: 教学收藏中的无锁骨骨架需要新的支架。

entries.en: The geologist marked the aclinal layer with a horizontal line.
entries.zh: 地质学家用一条水平线标出了无倾角的地层。

entries.en: The desk was aclutter with receipts and unopened envelopes.
entries.zh: 桌上乱七八糟地堆满了收据和未拆的信封。

entries.en: The questionnaire included a separate section for people with acne-prone skin.
entries.zh: 问卷为皮肤易长粉刺的人单列了一个部分。

entries.en: The entomologist labelled the acone units in the compound-eye diagram.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在复眼图中标出了无晶锥的小眼单元。

entries.meaningZh: 消除疲乏的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The advertisement promised acopic effects but offered no supporting evidence.
entries.zh: 广告声称能消除疲乏，却没有给出支持证据。

entries.en: The cabinet held acotyledonous specimens collected during the expedition.
entries.zh: 柜子里存放着考察期间采集的无子叶标本。

entries.en: The engineer compared the acoustoelectric readings before and after adjusting the device.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了调整装置前后的声电读数。

entries.en: The anatomy course included a detailed diagram of acral structures.
entries.zh: 解剖课程包含一幅肢体末端结构的详细示意图。

entries.en: An acrandrous shoot occupied the center of the botanical plate.
entries.zh: 那幅植物图版中央画着一枝雄器顶生的枝条。

entries.en: The curator moved the acraspedote specimen into a larger jar.
entries.zh: 馆长把那份无缘水母部标本移进了更大的瓶子。

entries.en: The acred landowner opposed the plan to divide the estate.
entries.zh: 那位拥有许多地产的地主反对分割庄园的计划。

entries.en: The students found the professor's acroamatic lectures difficult to follow.
entries.zh: 学生们觉得教授那些深奥的讲授难以听懂。

entries.en: The museum restricted photography of the acrocephalic skull in the teaching collection.
entries.zh: 博物馆限制拍摄教学收藏中那具尖头畸形颅骨。

entries.en: The acrocephalous skull was shown from three angles in the report.
entries.zh: 报告从三个角度展示了那具尖头颅骨。

entries.en: The field notes mention acrochroic petals but give no color sketch.
entries.zh: 野外笔记提到顶端有色的花瓣，却没有附彩色素描。

entries.en: The drawing shows an acrogynous shoot beside a sectioned specimen.
entries.zh: 图中画着一枝雌器顶生的枝条，旁边是一份剖开的标本。

entries.en: The anatomy instructor outlined the acromial edge on the teaching model.
entries.zh: 解剖教师在教学模型上勾出了肩峰边缘。

entries.meaningZh: 黄昏或日没后出没的〔天文学〕
entries.en: The astronomy exercise asked students to calculate the star's acronychal rising.
entries.zh: 天文学练习要求学生计算那颗星在日落时升起的时刻。

entries.en: The entomologist magnified the acrotergal region to check the damaged margin.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家放大了端背片区域，检查受损的边缘。

entries.en: The designer sketched an actinian lampshade with a ring of curling arms.
entries.zh: 设计师画了一个海葵似的灯罩，周围环绕着卷曲的臂状结构。

entries.meaningZh: 果实呈辐射状的〔植物学〕
entries.en: The botanist sketched an actinocarpous fruit from above.
entries.zh: 植物学家从上方画下了一个辐射果。

entries.en: The engineer recalibrated the sensor before testing its actinodielectric response.
entries.zh: 工程师先重新校准传感器，再测试它的光敏介电响应。

entries.en: An actinodrome leaf lay beside the student's unfinished drawing.
entries.zh: 一片具掌状脉的叶子放在学生未完成的画旁。

entries.en: The actinogenic equipment appeared only in the specialist appendix of the catalog.
entries.zh: 那套射线发生设备只出现在目录的专业附录中。

entries.en: The magnified photograph revealed the creature's actinophorous surface.
entries.zh: 放大照片显示出那只生物的体表具辐射刺。

entries.en: The zoologist identified the fossil fish as an actinopterygian.
entries.zh: 动物学家鉴定那条鱼化石属于辐鳍亚纲。

entries.en: The action-packed finale left little time to resolve the family's argument.
entries.zh: 这段情节紧张刺激的收尾，几乎没留时间来解决那家人的争执。
